body:
Greg's roadmap direction (via Engram::Asistant, TermAl mailbox 588693a8 #1865, 2026-11-16 01:56Z). This is product direction only: agree no unagreed details or new architecture from it. EO and sync stay the priority.
1. Closing EO and sync: accepted.
2. Work optimization is a CONTINUOUS process, especially context use and KV caching.
3. Work on other applications is already partly happening; Greg says TermAl currently has the largest Engram base.
4. He agrees with the detachable-federation direction.
5. The view and operator surface are part of work optimization.
6. Mobile: Telegram, including file sending, covers the mobile role well. He sees no justification for 2-3 months on a separate mobile frontend. Small UI fixes may run in parallel.
7. THE MOST IMPORTANT NEED: a simple Engram sync in the style of git push / git pull.
Kimi updates the roadmap draft and explains to Greg what it meant by "backend organizacyjny".
